texts.li: [lowtech,tale] {X_nameDef}, a wandering bard of {FACTION}, has come to spend an evening by the colony's fire. Tales for supper, songs for a bed: the old bargain. And {X_nameDef} has heard of this place already. They tell it like this on the road: "{TALE}"

[lowtech,notale] {X_nameDef}, a wandering bard of {FACTION}, has come to spend an evening by the colony's fire. Tales for supper, songs for a bed: the old bargain. Anyone who gathers round tonight is in for a treat.

[!lowtech,tale] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, a travelling storyteller with a battered instrument and a hundred stories, is stopping for the night. {X_nameDef} already knows a story about this colony, and tells it like this: "{TALE}"

[!lowtech,notale] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, a travelling storyteller with a battered instrument and a hundred stories, is stopping for the night. Anyone who gathers round this evening is in for a treat.

lines.li: ...and that's why you never trust a muffalo...
...on the far side of the mountains...

texts.li: Travellers from {FACTION} are on their way to the colony, asking for the grave of {DEAD}. They knew {DEAD} long before the colony did: family, or as good as. They've come to stand at the grave for a while, and then they'll go.
[lowtech] Word of {DEAD}'s death travelled further than anyone thought. Kin from {FACTION} are walking in to pay their respects at the grave, as their custom is.
[!lowtech] Someone from {FACTION} found {DEAD}'s name in a settlement record and has come all this way with family to see the grave. They won't stay long.

[lowtech] A small band of pilgrims of {FACTION}, footsore and thin, is walking up to the colony. Their road is long and their bags are empty, and they ask, very politely, for a meal before they go on.

[!lowtech] A handful of travellers of {FACTION} have stopped at the edge of the colony, on their way somewhere better, or so they hope. Their rations ran out three days ago. They ask, very politely, for a meal.
[winter] Pilgrims of {FACTION} have come in out of the cold, half frozen and wholly hungry, asking for a meal and a little warmth before they go on.

li.label: Feed them
li.outcome: The pilgrims eat like they haven't in days, because they haven't. They leave blessings behind them, and tell everyone they meet.

li.label: Turn them away
li.outcome: The pilgrims bow, and go on hungry.

texts.li: [lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a wandering scholar of {FACTION} with ink-stained fingers and a satchel of books, asks for a bed for the night. On hearing that the colony is working on {TALE}, {X_nameDef}'s eyes light up: {X_pronoun} has thoughts on that. Many thoughts.

[!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a travelling engineer of {FACTION}, asks for a bunk for the night. Someone mentions the colony's work on {TALE}, and {X_nameDef} immediately asks to see the notes. "Oh, no, no, no," {X_nameDef} says, smiling. "Let me show you."

li.label: Host {X_objective} for the night
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} talk until the fire burns out. In the morning, the colony's notes on {TALE} are twice as long and half as wrong.

li.label: No room tonight
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} shrugs and moves on. Somewhere else will get those notes.

texts.li: A young traveller named {X_nameDef} has come a long way with one question: is this where {A_nameDef} lives? Word of {A_nameDef}'s {SKILL} has spread further than anyone here knew, and {X_nameDef} wants to learn from the best. {X_nameDef} asks to stay as {A_nameDef}'s apprentice.

[lowtech] {X_nameDef}, barely more than a child, turns up at the edge of the colony asking for the master of {SKILL} the whole valley talks about. That's {A_nameDef}, apparently. {X_nameDef} will work for board and lessons, and asks to stay.

li.label: Take {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has a student. {A_nameDef} pretends to grumble about it, and fails.

li.label: Send {X_objective} home
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} goes, disappointed. {A_nameDef} is quieter than usual that evening.

texts.li: A stranger called {X_nameDef} has been waiting at the edge of the colony since dawn, and asks to stay. {X_nameDef} answers every question politely and none of them completely. Where from? "Far." Why here? "Why not." {A_nameDef} thinks {X_pronoun} is running from something. {A_nameDef} also thinks {X_pronoun} looks like a hard worker.

[lowtech] {X_nameDef} came out of the woods with good boots, empty hands and a name that might be real. {X_nameDef} asks to stay, and wants to know very little about anyone, and to be known even less. {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} first.

[!lowtech] {X_nameDef} walked in off the road with a good coat, no papers and a story that changes slightly every time it's told. {X_nameDef} asks to stay. {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} first, and thinks there's more to the story.

li.label: Everyone deserves a fresh start
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is one of us now. Whatever {X_pronoun} left behind, {X_pronoun} hasn't said.

texts.li: A child has wandered into the colony: {X_nameDef}, of {FACTION}, muddy, scared and very far from home. {A_nameDef} found {X_objective} sitting by the fields, trying hard not to cry. Somewhere out there, a family is searching.

[winter] {A_nameDef} found a child out in the cold, half frozen and too frightened to speak: {X_nameDef}, of {FACTION}, who followed something into the woods and couldn't find the way back. Somewhere out there, a family is searching.

li.label: Take {X_objective} home
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is walked back towards {X_possessive} people, clutching a bit of bread and somebody's spare coat. {FACTION} won't forget this.

li.label: Keep {X_objective}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stays. Whether {X_pronoun} wanted to is a question nobody asks out loud.

texts.li: A stray {THING} has followed {A_nameDef} all the way home and refuses to leave {A_possessive} side. It's thin, it's filthy, and it has very clearly decided {A_nameDef} is its person now.

[child] A stray {THING} followed {A_nameDef} home, and {A_nameDef} has already given it a name, a bowl and a corner of {A_possessive} bed. The look on {A_possessive} face says the matter is not up for discussion.
[hunter] A scrawny stray {THING} has been hanging around {A_nameDef} all day, bringing small dead things as gifts. It seems to think the colony could use a hunter.

li.label: It can stay
li.outcome: The {THING} curls up at {A_nameDef}'s feet as if it had always lived here.

li.label: Let it go
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walks the {THING} to the edge of the fields and leaves it there. It sits and watches {A_objective} go.
